name: LZR 308 240 MAX (Lazer, 240 gr)

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .308, Grains 240, Minimum Required Twist *1-6", Part Number LZR 308 240 MAX, G1 BC .696 (Oehler 89), G7 BC .339 (Oehler 89), OAL 2.037", Bullet Projection 1.442"
